mapper.select: SELECT * FROM knowledge_bases WHERE owner_id=#{ownerId} ORDER BY created_at DESC
SELECT * FROM knowledge_bases WHERE owner_id=#{ownerId} AND category=#{category}
SELECT * FROM knowledge_bases WHERE owner_id=#{ownerId} AND LOWER(name) LIKE CONCAT('%',LOWER(#{keyword}),'%')
SELECT * FROM knowledge_bases WHERE owner_id=#{ownerId} AND vector_status=#{vectorStatus}
SELECT * FROM knowledge_bases WHERE id IN #{item} AND vector_status=#{vectorStatus}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO knowledge_bases (id,owner_id,name,category,original_filename,file_size,content_type,original_bytes,content,vector_status,vector_error,chunk_count,created_at,updated_at,source_url,source_title,source_fetched_at,source_hash) VALUES (#{id},#{ownerId},#{name},#{category},#{originalFilename},#{fileSize},#{contentType},#{originalBytes},#{content},#{vectorStatus},#{vectorError},#{chunkCount},#{createdAt},#{updatedAt},#{sourceUrl},#{sourceTitle},#{sourceFetchedAt},#{sourceHash}) ON CONFLICT (id) DO UPDATE SET category=EXCLUDED.category,original_bytes=EXCLUDED.original_bytes,vector_status=EXCLUDED.vector_status,vector_error=EXCLUDED.vector_error,chunk_count=EXCLUDED.chunk_count,updated_at=EXCLUDED.updated_at
